mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material (material_no, material_name, specification, unit, price, stock, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{materialNo}, #{materialName}, #{specification}, #{unit}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE material SET material_name=#{materialName}, specification=#{specification}, unit=#{unit}, price=#{price}, stock=#{stock}, status=#{status}, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material
AND (material_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR material_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
